g.text: PARAPHRASE
"so the pain
moved up…"
REFLECT
"sounds
frightening…"
CLARIFY
"when you say
dizzy…?"
SUMMARISE
"so far: … did
I get it?"
LADDER: paraphrase (content mirror!) → reflect (feelings mirror!) → clarify (fuzzy
words!) → summarise (whole picture + check!). Each ends with a CHECK ("did I get that
right?") — corrections are GIFTS, not failures.
PARAPHRASE: "so the pain started low, then moved to your shoulder yesterday…" — shorter,
plain, THEIR facts. Proves listening; invites correction; slows rushing minds.
REFLECT: "sounds frightening…", "you feel guilty about the fall…", "part of you wants the
surgery, part dreads it…" — feelings NAMED, gently, tentatively ("sounds…", "seems…").
CLARIFY: "when you say 'dizzy', do you mean spinning or faint…?", "tell me what 'not
serious' means to you…" — vague words KILL assessments (dizzy? tired? "small" bleeding?).
SUMMARISE: "so far: 3 days of shoulder-moving pain, scared it's your heart, missing market
days — did I get it? what should we tackle first?" — mid-talk + end-talk + handover gold
(M06 SBAR!).
TEACH-BACK (NUT's gift!): "to be sure I explained well — how will you take these?" — checks
MY teaching, not their brains. Failed teach-back = re-teach differently (pictures! demos!).
CONFRONT KINDLY: "you say the drugs are fine, but the packet is full — help me understand…"
— facts + curiosity, NEVER accusation. Discrepancy named gently opens truth.
SELF-DISCLOSURE: tiny + rare + FOR them ("I felt scared before my surgery too — what
worries you most?") — never story-swapping. Their stage, always.
LINKS: M02 feelings-first · NUT counsel · PRO-I consent clarity.
MANTRA: "mirror content, name feelings, check fuzzy, sum + verify."
